# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM and WinUI fixes**

## Highlights

This in-progress 3.119.5 servicing release backports Apple 26.0 support and fixes a WinUI projection DLL issue.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Apple 26.0 library backported** — Unversioned app TFMs now work against the Apple 26.0 native library. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI projection DLL restored** — Fixed the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))
